title: Testing Python Code
description: Learn how to write effective tests using pytest and standard library tools.

sections.title: Why Tests Exist
sections.markdown: Automated tests ensure that your code works as expected and prevents regressions when changes are made. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.
key_points: Key point for Why Tests Exist

sections.title: What is a Unit Test?
sections.learning_objective: Understand What is a Unit Test?
sections.markdown: Unit tests focus on a small, isolated piece of code, usually a single function or class method. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.
key_points: Key point for What is a Unit Test?

sections.title: pytest Basics
sections.markdown: The `pytest` framework makes writing unit tests easy with minimal boilerplate. Just prefix functions with `test_`. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.

sections.title: Assertions
sections.markdown: Assertions verify that the actual output matches the expected output using the standard `assert` keyword in pytest. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.

sections.title: Pytest Fixtures
sections.markdown: Fixtures provide setup and teardown for your tests. They are reusable dependencies injected into test functions. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.

sections.title: Parametrization
sections.markdown: Parametrization allows running the same test function with multiple sets of inputs and expected outputs. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.

sections.title: Mocking Boundaries
sections.markdown: Mocking boundaries means replacing external dependencies (like databases or APIs) with fake objects to isolate unit tests. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.

sections.title: Test Determinism
sections.markdown: Tests should be deterministic. A determinism lack leads to flaky tests, which erode trust in the test suite. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.

sections.title: Testing Edge Cases
sections.markdown: Always test boundaries: empty lists, null values, negative numbers, and extremely large inputs. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.
key_points: Key point for Testing Edge Cases

sections.title: Integration Tests
sections.markdown: Integration tests verify that different components of your system work together correctly, unlike isolated unit tests. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.

sections.title: Test-Driven Development (TDD)
sections.markdown: TDD is a methodology where you write tests before writing the actual implementation code. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.

sections.title: Interview Takeaways
sections.markdown: Interviewers may ask you to write tests for your code on a whiteboard or explain when to mock. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.
